 		<constant name="COMPRESS_SOURCE_NORMAL" value="2" enum="CompressSource">
 			Source texture (before compression) is a normal texture (e.g. it can be compressed into two channels).
 		</constant>
+		<constant name="COMPRESS_PROFILE_MAX_QUALITY" value="0" enum="CompressProfile">
+			Prioritizes highest quality over compression. For ASTC, this corresponds to using a 4x4 block size.
+		</constant>
+		<constant name="COMPRESS_PROFILE_BALANCED" value="1" enum="CompressProfile">
+			Automatically adjusts the quality level based on the amount of unique color channels present in the image. For ASTC, this corresponds to picking 8x8 when only one channel is detected (R, L), 6x6 when two channels are detected (RG, RA, LA), and 4x4 in all other cases.
+		</constant>
+		<constant name="COMPRESS_PROFILE_COMPRESSED" value="2" enum="CompressProfile">
+			Prioritizes some compression over quality. For ASTC, this corresponds to using a 6x6 block size.
+		</constant>
+		<constant name="COMPRESS_PROFILE_MAX_COMPRESSION" value="3" enum="CompressProfile">
+			Prioritizes highest compression over quality. For ASTC, this corresponds to using a 8x8 block size.
+		</constant>
+		<constant name="COMPRESS_PROFILE_MAX" value="4" enum="CompressProfile">
+			Represents the size of the [enum CompressProfile] enum.
+		</constant>
body:
"Compress Profile Compressed" sounds a bit odd. I would go for these instead:

- Automatic (`COMPRESS_PROFILE_BALANCED = 0`, move to enum 0 as it's automatic behavior and should be first as it's also the default)
- Quality (`COMPRESS_PROFILE_QUALITY = 1`, formerly `COMPRESS_PROFILE_MAX_QUALITY`)
- Balanced (`COMPRESS_PROFILE_BALANCED = 2`, formerly `COMPRESS_PROFILE_COMPRESSED`)
- Performance (`COMPRESS_PROFILE_PERFORMANCE = 3`, formerly `COMPRESS_PROFILE_MAX_COMPRESSION`)

In general, it's better for enum values not to contain `_MAX` as it makes autocompletion a bit more annoying to work with (due to the presence of `COMPRESS_PROFILE_MAX` in results).

body:
I don't think these new names actually communicate the behaviour or intended purpose well. 

Balanced -> automatic is a good change, but compressed -> balanced is not a good change. Balanced implies it is a good tradeoff that makes the most sense in most cases and is safe to use by default. ASTC 6x6 is not a good format for most cases. Most people should stick with 4x4. 6x6 is only good when you are willing to lose some quality. If anything it should be 6x6 -> compressed 8x8 -> extreme compression
